labels.realized: realized_net_usd comes from the venue's settlement figure and from nothing else. It is absent, not zero, for every episode that has not settled.
labels.pair_gross: pair_gross_usd is DERIVED, pre-fee and pre-incentive, and is refused when venue and ledger quantities do not reconcile. Locked is not realized.
labels.incentive: venue_incentive_usd is what the venue actually credited on our fills. Absent means no incentive evidence was supplied, never that the venue paid nothing.
labels.absent_vs_zero: A field belonging to a stage the episode never reached is null. Zero is a measurement; null is the absence of one.
